# ⚠️ Responsible Disclosure Notice

Please **DO NOT** report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues.

If you have discovered a potential security vulnerability in Kasuwa:
1. Review the Security policy in [README.md](../../README.md#security).
2. Email full reproduction steps and details to **security@your-domain.example**.
3. Allow up to 72 hours for initial acknowledgment before any public discussion.
